_doc: AgentCake's page script (cake.js). tools/build_js.py puts the 'script' object into agentcake/static/cake.js as CFG, with the data files under 'build' -> 'data' added (privacy.json's rules become CFG.privacy, agent_markers.json's page part CFG.markers); no number or name is written in the script sources. 'build' lists the sources in the order they are put together (paths relative to agentcake/). Units are in the key names; _bytes limits count JSON characters, except keepalive_max_bytes, which counts the bytes on the wire. The upload format is docs/collect-format.md.

parts.name: rrweb record
parts.source: rrweb-io/rrweb, record UMD build as shipped with cake 0.3.x (local source checked at commit 3339038d)

parts.name: BotD
parts.source: @fingerprintjs/botd 2.0.0, dist/botd.esm.js; telemetry and export removed (see the file's header)

parts.source: botscent 1.2.0 on npm, dist/botscent.js, unchanged (github.com/nalinbhardwaj/botscent commit 7f948003)

session.$comment: How sessions are cut (session.js; the collector applies the same rules to a tab's uploads from scripts that do not, session_split.py): PostHog's time rules (posthog-js packages/browser/src/sessionid.ts: DEFAULT_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 30 minutes, SESSION_LENGTH_LIMIT_MILLISECONDS 24 hours), for the browser's session, which every tab of the site shares through localStorage, and for each tab's own part of it. Activity is what PostHog counts: its recorder's ACTIVE_SOURCES (lazy-loaded-session-recorder.ts: MouseMove, MouseInteraction, Scroll, ViewportResize, Input, TouchMove, MediaInteraction, Drag), as the raw input records that stand for them (activity_raw; a geometry record whose why is in activity_geo), and a page view, a page load or a new path (activity_signals). The clocks are written at most every persist_every_ms, and when the page is left; a tab reads the browser's clock again at most every persist_every_ms of its own activity, and always before ending the browser's session for idleness. record: the signal record that begins a new session on a page, with why it began: idle and max by the rules, reset for window.cake.reset(), tab when another tab began the browser's next session.

navigation.$comment: A single-page app's page view (navigation.js): the record cake.js sends when location.pathname changes within a page load, as posthog-js counts a $pageview (capture_pageview 'history_change': the path, not the query string or the fragment).

visitor.$comment: The visitor id (visitor.js): kept in localStorage for max_age_ms after its last use, as PostHog's anonymous id is kept for cookie_expiration 365 days (posthog-js posthog-core.ts).

identify.$comment: window.cake.identify(id) and window.cake.reset() (identify.js), as posthog-js's identify() and reset() (posthog-core.ts). The browser sends only algorithm(site key + separator + id) in hexadecimal (the header's idh), never the id. An id is a non-empty string or a number, and not one of refused (posthog-js's _validateIdentifyId and isDistinctIdStringLike: placeholders, compared ignoring case). commands: the names a queued call (window.cake.push) uses. fault: where cake.js notes why an identify() did nothing (an 'err' record), with not_an_id or no_crypto as the message, never the value.
identify.not_an_id: identify() needs a non-empty string or a number as the id
identify.no_crypto: identify() needs the browser's SubtleCrypto (a page on https or localhost)

source.$comment: Where a page view came from (source.js), as posthog-js event-utils.ts reads it: the campaign parameters PostHog's channel rules read (CAMPAIGN_PARAMS: the five UTM parameters and gad_source), each value cut to max_chars, and the ad-click parameters whose presence only is sent (PERSONAL_DATA_CAMPAIGN_PARAMS).
